{{Quote|Hey, Thanamiroc can look like anything. Farmers, Sand People, Imperial soldiers, Rebels, baby banthas, you name it. Just kidding about the banthas. Whatever he looks like, he's always trouble.|Bren Kingal|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Trone Thanamiroc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] master of disguise, and member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. According to [[Bren Kingal]], he was also murderer who went on killing sprees. However, this may have been yet another of Kingal's countless lies, in order to encourage a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to seek out and kill Thanamiroc. Ultimately, Thanamiroc, who was posing as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], was killed by the spacer. The spacer brought back proof of his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the form of an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-ST pilot]] helmet.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBountyHunter.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Thanamiroc]]
Trone Thanamiroc was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the appearance of Trone Thanamiroc changed each time a player performed this quest. The quest dialogue given by Bren Kingal indicated that Thanamiroc was a male, but no mention was made of his species, and he could appear in many different forms. For this particular quest, Thanamiroc would spawn under the bounty hunter spawn template, allowing him to appear like a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] male wearing [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], or even as an [[IG-series/Legends|IG assassin droid]].
